confirmation_policy: All Train history is known development evidence; no independent OOS, Historical Valid or Valid access.

feature_definitions.ResidualReturn: provided raw_return - provided beta * provided TOPIX on exact Date/Code, finite only, identical existing market residual primitive; no fitted beta/factor model
feature_definitions.IndustryResidualReturn: each historical date u, actual present raw_return rows with exact PIT33(u); self-inclusive equal mean of finite ResidualReturn, minimum5; missing/9999/blank excluded. No LOO or signal-date membership retrospectively applied
feature_definitions.StockMom20: within unchanged Code/relisting segments: residual.shift(1).rolling(20,min_periods=20).sum(); one skipped current observation, prior20 observations ending at preceding observed stock row
feature_definitions.IndustryMom20: industry residual daily history on raw-return exchange calendar; shift1 then rolling20 min20 sum; missing/insufficient-member dates stay NaN, not compressed; map current PIT33(t) to that industry history
feature_definitions.timing: both horizon20/skip1/previous-observation endpoint. Stock uses existing per-Code observed rows; industry uses industry exchange observations. Stock gaps can mean different calendar spans, saved as diagnostic; no alternate timing trial
feature_definitions.Within33Rev20: -Within33Mom20; sign registered from external literature, not post-hoc sign reversal of previous Train candidates
feature_definitions.scaling: unchanged same-date centered average percentile rank on finite raw values, zero missing after transform; each component separately
feature_definitions.missing: raw retains NaN for coverage. component ranks neutral0 after ranking; combined raw coverage requires both finite, predictions cover every required row. No availability filter
feature_definitions.state: existing >20 absent exchange-date relisting segment reset; sector change keeps per-Code EWMA history; no extra reset

model: Three fixed formula scores; no fitted parameters, ML, regression/PCA or sign/weight/horizon/alpha searches
selection_rule: All3 trials terminate. Components: REJECT if any feasibility gate fails, otherwise FEASIBLE_COMPONENT_ONLY (no standalone adoption rule). Combined: NEXT_STAGE_ELIGIBLE only if all feasibility and combined gates pass; else REJECT. No Freeze/Valid/submission. No fourth performance candidate.

bootstrap.method: paired circular moving-block on identical concatenated eligible sessions

diagnostics.industry_only: raw industry20 cross-industry RankIC/HAC5/year, equal-sector target terciles, dispersion, mean absolute percentile-rank change proxy; original candidate sector P/L contribution only; no industry-only portfolio or Net trial
diagnostics.within: raw Within sign +/-/zero/missing, A(++),B(+-),C(-+),D(--), forward target equal-row/equal-date and original-book attribution; no filter
diagnostics.lead_lag: one fixed prior-exchange-observation IndustryResidualReturn assigned current PIT33, includes own historical return; compare association to own prior residual and within-sector target. Lag1 only; no LOO, leader/search/network/trading score. Self-inclusion precludes pure peer identification.
diagnostics.breadth: Sector33 side-normalized HHI/max, Q1/Q5 distribution, top2 contribution, original-book LOSO subtract attributed P/L/cost without rerank; no exclusions
diagnostics.persistence: daily turnover/cost, rank autocorrelation, quintile retention, contiguous observed tail spells (gap reset, censor disclosed), absolute percentile rank changes and MOM60 tail overlap
diagnostics.coverage: raw stock/industry/within masks by ALL_TRAIN/POOLED/EX2016/year and Sector33; minimum-member failures daily and trailing-window; calendar-span timing differences
diagnostics.metrics: MeanRankIC/HAC5/hit, Gross/NetSR, annualGross/Net/Cost, turnover, compound/additive DD, Q1-Q5/Q5-Q1/monotonicity, Long/Short gross/net/SR/turnover/cost, period sums; 2016 separately
